candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of opioid addiction, drug trafficking, and related pharmaceuticals and crises.
This feature vector activates on adverbs and adjectives describing the manner, intensity, or legality of actions and events.
This feature vector activates strongly on biomedical, neurological, and biochemical roots, prefixes, and chemical suffixes.
This vector represents terminology related to medicine, pharmacology, and biological sciences.
This feature vector represents concepts related to comparison, differentiation, and relative evaluation between items or states.
These tokens represent quantifier words indicating indefinite quantities across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on medical, biological, and chemical terminology related to bodily substances, systems, and treatments.
These tokens represent modal verbs expressing possibility, permission, or obligation across multiple European languages.
This vector represents words denoting scale, degree, or quantity across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents logical connectors, transitional adverbs, and conjunctions used to indicate consequence, sequence, or contrast across multiple languages.
